name: Tilt (f.k.a. Delphia)
description:
Everything is (becoming) investable, so why not invest in ideas before they become ETFs.

Tilt is building the audited methodology layer agents call before touching portfolios. As agents begin managing real portfolios, they need a neutral trusted source of verified investment logic before they can act.

We operate across two connected surfaces: InvestOS, an open standard that lets any brokerage or platform plug verified methodology into its own AI experience; and Tilt, the reference implementation of InvestOS. Tilt is an agentic harness where investors, portfolio managers, and creators can author, remix, and publish strategies. 

If you're thinking about working here, our mission is to price the world's information.

founders.bio: Andrew is an entrepreneur and angel investor. He's the founder and CEO of Agora Intelligence, makers of Tilt — an open standard for rules-based investment methodology. Prior to Tilt, he co-founded Delphia, an investment collective where people pooled data to access investment strategies. Delphia built and sold a systematic hedge fund (to Acadian) alongside other investment technologies using ML.
